skill: Communicating between the technical and non-technical
expected_level_description: You can: - communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders - support and host discussions within a multidisciplinary team, with potentially difficult dynamics - be an advocate for the team externally - manage differing stakeholder perspectives
You can: - undertake data profiling and source system analysis - present clear insights to colleagues to support the end use of the data

You can: - consistently apply data ethics, legislation, internal procedures, policies and technologies to ensure secure data handling - help ensure your team remain compliant by identifying and addressing current and potential data compliance and ethical issues - guide and support others in addressing data compliance issues

You can: - lead the implementation of complex or large-scale data solutions - apply appropriate technology and techniques to ensure data solutions are secure and scalable - identify and implement continuous improvement to the operation and performance of data solutions

You can: - experiment with unfamiliar and emerging technologies, or familiar technologies in new data contexts, with guidance - share what you learn with the team, explaining potential benefits, risks, and practical considerations - identify opportunities to apply technology to improve data processes or outcomes in an operational setting or the wider organisation

You can: - select the most appropriate techniques for different integration scenarios - evaluate and lead the implementation of integration using varied approaches that ensure security, efficiency and compliance

You can: - produce relevant data models across multiple subject areas - explain which models to use for which purpose - understand industry-recognised data modelling patterns and standards, and when to apply them - compare and align different data models

You can: - design an appropriate metadata repository - suggest changes to improve current metadata repositories - understand a range of tools for storing and working with metadata - advise less experienced members of the team about metadata management

You can: - initiate and monitor actions to investigate patterns and trends to resolve problems - effectively consult specialists where required - determine the appropriate resolution and assist with its implementation - determine preventative measures

skill: Programming and build (data and analytics engineering)
expected_level_description: You can: - lead the design, code, testing and deployment of secure, resilient and maintainable solutions - continuously improve the codebase and reliability of solutions - create automation to improve the software development life cycle - work with others to implement standards and good practice to ensure security, testability and maintainability of solutions

You can: - explain the clinical and care workflows your work supports - use common health care terms correctly with clinical and care colleagues - recognise when a change could affect patient care and raise it

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements

You can: - design and build integrations using FHIR, HL7 version 2, and messaging patterns - write and profile FHIR resources and implementation guides - resolve complex mapping and data quality issues between systems
You can: - find and use the right codes for a data item or form - use terminology browsers and reference sets

You can: - design pseudonymisation and linkage methods that keep identifiers separate from analysis data - assess the re-identification risk of a data set or publication and choose suitable controls - advise teams on safe settings, such as trusted research environments
You can: - take part in hazard workshops and contribute to a hazard log - follow the clinical risk management process for your work - provide evidence for a clinical safety case, such as test results
